player_prompt.intro:
Wɔde Tower of Hanoi a ɛwɔ {num_disks} disks di agorɔ.
Wopɛ sɛ wobɛtu disk no firi tower A kɔ tower C.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotumi tu disk, kae source tower ne target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Hwe a, wuhu sɛ wotumi tu ahyɛnsode a ɛwɔ wɔ tower no so, na disk a ɛkɔ a ɛyɛ kɛse nnidi bi a ɛyɛ kɛkɛe.
Wɔ berɛ a wɔbɛka no, san kɔso a wobɛka.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Woka nnyɛ fɔm a ɛyɛ pɛ '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: W'akyerɛkyerɛ beae a efi anaa abantenten no mu sɛ ɛmfata.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Woyɛɛ sɛ wobɛsoa disk bi afi abantenten a hwee nni so mu.
invalid_move.same_tower: Woyɛɛ sɛ wobɛsoa disk no akɔ abantenten koro no ara mu.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Woyɛɛ w'adwene sɛ wode disk kɛse bi bɛhyɛ disket ketewa bi so.

outcome.win: Anigye! Woadi Hanoi Abantenten no ho nsɛnnennen ano.
outcome.turn_limit: Wode {pct}% disks no asi Tower C so yiye.
